name: Your Rouh's URL
title: Your Rouh's URL: its own web address through rouh.land's relay, locked end to end, off until the owner turns it on, with an (i) saying what kind of URL it is; on Your Rouh

permissions: asks the relay's claim endpoint for this Rouh's address at birth, signed with its daily key, only when it was born Connected
runs frp's client, which keeps one line open to the relay while the owner has the address on
gets and renews a Let's Encrypt certificate for its own address
touches.remove: the phoneBody box in Your Rouh's section of rouh/templates/rouh/index.html, phonepage.js/.css, rouh/relay.py, rouh/acme.py, rouh/web/relay.py and its routes, the relay lines in rouh/web/gate.py, rouh/web/auth.py, rouh/web/firstrun.py and rouh/runtime.py, phone_in.html, frpc in deploy/container/Dockerfile.base and this manifest; delete the data folder's relay/.
